items.title: Chair/Professor in International Business (Teaching and Research)
items.department: Innovation Management and Policy · Manchester
items.note: Lead international-business research, doctoral supervision and research-led teaching while mentoring colleagues and pursuing external funding. Internationally recognised scholarship in international business or a related field, with evidence of contribution to the discipline. Formal degree criteria are not stated on the accessible advert. Permanent; 35. Advertised cut-off: Midnight on the closing date; check the employer’s instructions.

items.title: Lecturer in Urban Planning (Fixed-term maternity cover)
items.department: Planning, Property and Environmental Management · Oxford Road, Manchester, United Kingdom
items.note: Teach planning and environmental management, supervise student dissertations and contribute to assessment. The maternity-cover appointment includes campus teaching and a real-estate research field class in Portugal. Relevant PhD; previous university teaching and supervision in urban planning; evidence of research-informed teaching and effective communication. Full time (1 FTE); Fixed term, six months (January–July 2027). Advertised cut-off: Midnight, as stated by the employer; check the employer’s instructions.

items.title: Lecturer in Pure Mathematics
items.department: Department of Mathematics · Oxford Road
items.note: Develop research in pure mathematics, particularly analysis or dynamical systems, and teach at undergraduate and postgraduate levels. PhD or equivalent research experience in mathematics or a related discipline; relevant publication record, subject knowledge and evidence of teaching potential. Permanent; Full time (1 FTE). The official numeric closing date is 26 November 2026. The weekday stated in the advert is inconsistent, so it is omitted. Advertised cut-off: Midnight on the closing date; check the employer’s instructions.

items.title: Lecturer or Senior Lecturer in AI-augmented Software Engineering
items.department: Department of Computer Science · Oxford Road, Manchester, United Kingdom
items.note: Teach and conduct research on how AI can support software engineering. The appointment includes developing software-engineering teaching, pursuing external funding and collaborating across computing research groups. The advert calls for research and teaching capability in AI-augmented software engineering. Applicants must submit an academic CV, a one-page research plan and a one-page teaching statement. Full-time, permanent. The employer advert gives 8 January 2027. A different date appears in the jobs.ac.uk header; the employer’s date is used here.

items.department: Campus Technology Services · Oxford Road
items.salary: £38,448 to £46,970 per annum depending on experience
items.note: Build cloud infrastructure and reusable automation for university services and research, including AI and machine-learning projects. items.department: Division of Informatics, Imaging & Data Science · Oxford Road
items.salary: £38,448 to £41,885 per annum, depending on relevant experience
items.note: Develop AI agents that combine cardiac images, ECGs and clinical information to support cardiologists' review and investigation decisions. Relevant PhD completed or near completion, strong Python and deep-learning skills and ability to evaluate AI methods. Medical-imaging or multimodal-AI experience is desirable. Fixed Term; Full Time; 12 months. Advertised cut-off: Midnight on the closing date; check the employer’s instructions.

items.title: Research Fellow in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning for Scientific Discovery
items.department: Department of Chemistry · Manchester Institute of Biotechnology
items.note: Develop predictive models and software for protein engineering and enzyme design, integrating biological, chemical and experimental data. Expertise in AI, machine learning, computer science, applied mathematics, statistics or a related quantitative field. Prior protein-science experience is advantageous but not required. Fixed Term; Full time (1 FTE); Fixed term for 24 months. jobs.ac.uk search result shows 10 November, but the directly opened official advert says 1 December 2026. Employer deadline takes precedence. Advertised cut-off: Midnight on the closing date; check the employer’s instructions.

items.title: Research Associate in EPR and Magnetism of Molecular Spin Qubits
items.department: Department of Chemistry · Oxford Road
items.salary: £37,694 - £46,049 per annum depending on relevant experience
items.note: Investigate molecular spin qubits with EPR spectroscopy and magnetometry, collaborating with US researchers and supporting junior scientists. PhD completed or expected in chemistry, physics or a related field, plus advanced spectroscopic or magnetic-measurement experience. Fixed Term; 1 FTE; 30 months. Advertised cut-off: Midnight on the closing date; check the employer’s instructions.

items.title: Research Associate in Particle Physics on ATLAS
items.department: Department of Physics & Astronomy · Oxford Road
items.salary: £38,448 - £46,970 per annum depending on relevant experience
items.note: Study weak-boson polarisation using ATLAS data and develop jet-reconstruction and tagging methods. The Manchester-based post involves frequent CERN visits. Particle-physics PhD or equivalent by the start date and relevant experience in analysis, modelling, triggers, detector operations or detector performance. Fixed Term; 35; Fixed term for 36 Months from 1st Jan 2027 or shortly thereafter. Advertised cut-off: Midnight on the closing date; check the employer’s instructions.

items.title: Research Associate in Organic Synthesis
items.department: Department of Chemistry · Manchester Institute of Biotechnology, Manchester, United Kingdom
items.note: Investigate new synthetic reactions that alter sugar molecular frameworks in the Miller group. The role includes reaction development, product characterisation and managing research outputs. PhD in organic chemistry focused on synthesis or methodology, with evidence of devising and troubleshooting experimental methods. Prior carbohydrate-chemistry experience is not required. Full-time, fixed-term for 12 months; planned start 1 January 2027. Advertised cut-off: Midnight on the closing date; check the employer’s instructions.

items.title: Dalton Research Fellow
items.department: Dalton Nuclear Institute · Manchester
items.salary: £48,337 - £59,390 per annum depending on relevant experience
items.note: Establish an independent nuclear-science or engineering research programme through a four-year fellowship, with funding development and researcher supervision. Relevant PhD or equivalent qualification/experience before starting; ability to build a research programme and team and demonstrate nuclear-sector relevance. Fixed Term; Full Time (1 FTE); 48 Months. Employer describes three fellowships under this reference and four posts across SAE-032060 and SAE-032063; applicants are asked to submit only one application under their preferred reference. Advertised cut-off: Midnight on the closing date; check the employer’s instructions.

Full time, 36.5 hours per week; permanent; hybrid with at least one campus day weekly.

items.salary: Starting from £27,241, rising to £30,986 pro rata

Higher-education or equivalent administrative experience, digital literacy and ability to manage complex workflows are requested; university-system experience is desirable. Part time, 22 hours per week; open ended; hybrid with at least two campus days.

items.department: School of Management · School of Management, University of Bath
items.note: Help undergraduates secure and complete placements, build employer relationships and deliver professional-development activities. The advert requests strong organisation, initiative, communication, diplomacy and cultural awareness; detailed requirements appear in the linked job description. Part time, 0.6 FTE; fixed term expected to end July 2027; hybrid. Part time at 0.6 FTE; salary range shown as in the advert, which does not explicitly label it pro rata.

items.department: Institute for Policy Research · University of Bath; exact work site not specified

The main advert does not specify qualification requirements; refer to the linked person specification. Agreed internal secondments and part-time work may be considered. Full time; fixed term; part time from 0.6 FTE may be considered.

items.title: Marketing Officer
items.department: School of Management · University of Bath
items.note: Develop student-recruitment campaigns, digital content, CRM communications and events, using campaign data to improve marketing. Significant marketing experience, content-creation and communication skills, and confidence managing projects and stakeholders are requested. Full time; fixed term for one year; hybrid available.

items.title: HRMI Coordinator
items.department: Human Resources · University of Bath; exact work site not specified
items.salary: Starting from £27,241, rising to £30,986 pro rota per annum
items.note: Prepare HR datasets, reports and dashboards, handle enquiries and support improvements to HR systems and processes. Good Excel and general IT skills, customer service, organisation and willingness to develop data skills are requested; higher-education or HR experience is beneficial, not essential. Part time, 0.6 FTE / 21.9 hours; open ended; job share.

items.note: Lead an exercise-physiology research programme alongside teaching, doctoral supervision and academic leadership. items.department: Leeds – Main Campus

items.department: Leeds – Main Campus
items.note: Investigate how alternative fuels affect marine-engine lubricants, friction and wear through testing rigs and analytical experiments. items.department: School of Civil Engineering · Leeds Main Campus, United Kingdom
items.note: Model heat transfer through retaining walls used as ground heat exchangers. Work with UK and Brazilian partners to improve design methods and practical guidance for energy walls. Relevant engineering PhD completed or submitted before starting, or equivalent research experience; thermal simulation expertise, knowledge of ground heat exchangers or energy geostructures, and a publication record. Full-time, fixed-term to 31 July 2027.

items.title: Research Fellow in Fate and Effects of Emerging Contaminants in Agricultural Systems
items.department: Leeds – Main Campus
items.note: Study how pharmaceuticals and other emerging contaminants move through agricultural environments and affect soils, crops and exposure pathways. PhD and contaminant-research experience in environmental chemistry, science, biology or a related field are requested. Full time, 37.5 hours weekly; fixed term until 30 September 2028.

items.department: Lloyds Banking Group, 11–12 Wellington Place, Leeds, UK
items.note: Develop windstorm-risk models with Lloyds Banking Group, connecting climate research and machine learning with insurance decision-making. The advert requests a PhD in atmospheric science, climate science, fluid dynamics or a related discipline. Full time; fixed term for 24 months.

items.department: Leeds – Main Campus
items.note: Develop theoretical and computational methods for quantum critical phenomena, using fuzzy-sphere approaches to simulate conformal field theories. The advert invites backgrounds in lattice gauge theory, nonequilibrium physics or computational quantum many-body research; full criteria are in the candidate brief. Full time; fixed term for 24 months.
